name: Motoko Hime Adventure
original_name: 素子姫アドベンチャー
source:
Motoko Hime is science fiction writer. After finishing writing a novel she was sucked into the novel and you're the only one who can save her.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
科幻作家新井素子写完一部小说后，竟被吸进自己创作的故事中。如今只有你能救她。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
